feedback: The score owns the field at full bleed; the diagonal reading path resolves on the win; the phrase "Tigers, by one." lands as its caption in small-caps flush right. The composition executes the brief—a one-run margin made the largest object on the page—with committed restraint. The scoreboard gold floats on the void, the dot ground reads as intentional material, and the masonry ledger below holds the night's other facts subordinate to the number. On the phone the hero folds alone at poster scale; the phrase and deck hold the idea across the width; the ledger follows in order. Type hierarchy, color coverage, canvas utilization all land. No measured failures, no brief shortfalls. Ship it.
